profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer | Performance & Platform | TypeScript / React / Node.js / AWS | Ex-Meta, Samsung, GoDaddy | Open to remote senior IC roles
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Meta, I contribute to high-impact projects, leveraging expertise in software design, TypeScript, and DevOps to deliver reliable and efficient technical solutions. My role reflects a commitment to enhancing performance and scalability while ensuring seamless development and deployment processes across platforms.  

I hold a Bachelor of Engineering in Systems and Computing Engineering from the University of the Andes. My professional journey includes experience with leading organizations like Factored and EPAM Systems, where I designed and optimized software architectures and improved code quality through rigorous testing. I aim to combine technical proficiency with collaborative problem-solving to create innovative and effective technological solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
On the Meta Managed Accounts team, I worked on the org-management workflows
that businesses use to run permissions and access across complex multi-entity
structures inside Meta Business Suite.

- Brought back a previously-removed progress indicator and cut load times
  by ~80% by redesigning the backend data access patterns in Hack and
  introducing strategic caching where it mattered most.
- Killed a scalability cliff that was breaking large-enterprise customers
  with thousands of sub-businesses, by swapping expensive in-memory
  computations for an indexed query strategy.
- Drove Engineering Excellence for test ineligibility on the team — cut
  ineligible test rates from ~20% down to ~5% (team target was 10%) by
  standardizing performant Hack + React test patterns.

What I took away: the highest-leverage perf wins almost always come from
fixing how data is fetched, not how it's rendered. Most "slow page" problems
are really N+1 queries in disguise.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Bogota, D.C., Capital District, Colombia · Remote
positions.description:
- Led the design and development of a pluggable Ads SDK for Samsung TV Plus, using JavaScript and React. 

- Implemented a heartbeat feature within the Samsung TV SPS CL JavaScript library, enabling the collection of critical app performance and usage metrics. 

- Revamped a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline for automated deployment to AWS S3 and CloudFront. Optimized efficiency and ensured code quality through linting, testing, and restructuring. 

- Improved code quality by increasing test coverage from 64% to 78%. Implemented unit tests with Jest and React Testing Library, ensuring stability and reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · Node.js · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leader of the website team that developed and supported several internal JavaScript libraries that send website metrics to GoDaddy’s traffic pipeline. 
- Optimized the traffic libraries using NodeJS and React to continue handling the 5m+ websites hosted by GoDaddy.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Maintained Paths, one of the main learning features on Pluralsight. Using Docker, React, Nodejs.
- Integrated multiple external services with Paths' queueing system using RabbitMQ

positions.title: SSR Web Engineer
positions.locationName: Bogota, D.C., Capital District, Colombia · Remote
positions.description:
- Lead FE development of multiple core components for Merck's website, a German multinational science and technology company.
- Part of a leadership committee of a 20-engineer team on Huge’s FCA account (Fiat Chrysler Automobiles). Optimizing the in-house Admire framework which handles the automatization of FCA’s targeted campaigns.

positions.title: Data Sourcing Tech Lead
positions.description:
- Directed a Product Squad of 6 members that plan, design and develop products concerning the retrieval and delivery of transactional behavior of Leal’s users when they accumulate and redeem points.
- Implemented agile scrum methodologies to deliver over 15 new integrations with different POS systems for automatized accumulation & redemption and the delivery of purchase information for future analytical purposes.
- Established CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, using Docker and Kubernetes for the deployment of the squad’s microservices and AWS Amplify for the frontend products

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the development of a new tool for cashiers to manage the client’s prizes and points, handling over 200k transactions per day. Used Electron and Cordova to package the app on both desktop and mobile, respectively.
- Integrated over 20 different POS systems with our platform for automated point accumulation and prize redemption. Connected to various database systems like SQL Server, MariaDB, MySQL, Oracle DB, etc.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Optimized the transactional services of the cashier’s platform in order to take in an increment of 100k new transactions per day due to the alliance made with Texaco Colombia.
- Developed a React Native points marketplace app as a White Label for the biggest department store in El Salvador, SIMAN. Implemented the backend and database logic with ExpressJS and MariaDB

positions.title: Jr. Front End Developer
positions.description: - Impacted over 400 establishments with startup/runtime performance optimizations on a SAAS CMS, by migrating it from PHP to Angular and implementing Lazy Loading, Tree Shaking, AOT-Compilation, etc.

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description: Implemented a Geo-Localization microservice on NodeJS for a Watson chatbot interface. The interface is on a MERN Stack and it lets clients build and customize chatbots to embed them in their own webpages.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Investigation projects:

-MRQ: Chemical risk map. Worked with 3 other developers to create a chemical risk map for the Valle de Aburrá area (Colombia). Developed in AngularJS with a Java EE backend connected to an SQL database.

- Research assistant for a doctoral project. Gathered insights and developed analytical graphics based on hundreds of surveys done to software architecture graduate students to study the technical debt in the software architecture discipline.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Courses: Data Structures. Web Development. Mobile apps construction. 

Guided 3rd semester students through different concepts around data structures like algorithm analysis (Big O notation), stacks, hashes, ordering and graphs.

Assisted 6th semester students in learning web development technologies, going from creating a simple landing page in html/css to a fullstack collaborative MERN app, introducing robust tools like Meteor and understanding its architecture and appliances.

Assisted last semester students in the development of mobile apps on Swift, Android and Kotlin while teaching them concepts aboud Design Thinking and agile development.

positions.title: Student Council Representative
positions.description: Attended monthly meetings with the teachers' faculty as the voice of the students. Organized 2 week long event for more than 700 students with recreational and programming activities.

positions.title: CTO
positions.description:
Established initial plans of IT infrastructure for the company.
Created chrome extension to analyze productivity of lawyers working for the company.
